title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
manual_steps: Story Mode only, with BattlEye disabled using the game launcher option (-nobattleye).
Select DLSS in the game (Quality was tested); leave the game's frame generation off. FreeFG enables XeFG through OptiFG.
Use the bundled OptiScaler 273e8d4 or a descendant with the Social Club factory fix; leave DxgiFactoryWrapping at auto/false and remove any SocialClubD3D12Renderer DLL-disable override.
note: GTA 1.0.1158.16, GE-Proton11-11, AMD FSR 4 RC12. The anti-cheat installation refusal still requires explicit per-game acceptance. The Social Club overlay stays available.
observed: Story Mode bank prologue, movement and Social Club open/close; sustained 2.0 generated presents per game frame, including a fresh start with XeFG enabled

qualification.limits: Two successful short Story Mode starts; no Online, long-play, 3x/4x, HDR or pacing qualification.
